verification_sql: SELECT combined.DocNum FROM (SELECT inv.DocNum, inv.CardCode, inv.DocStatus FROM dbo.OINV inv WHERE inv.DocDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate UNION ALL SELECT rcm.DocNum, rcm.CardCode, rcm.DocStatus FROM dbo.ORIN rcm WHERE rcm.DocDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate) combined WHERE (@CardCode IS NULL OR combined.CardCode = @CardCode) AND (@DocStatus = 'ALL' OR combined.DocStatus = @DocStatus)

SELECT MIN(combined.DocTotal - combined.PaidToDate) AS UnpaidAmount FROM (SELECT inv.DocTotal, inv.PaidToDate, inv.CardCode, inv.DocStatus FROM dbo.OINV inv WHERE inv.DocDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate UNION ALL SELECT rcm.DocTotal, rcm.PaidToDate, rcm.CardCode, rcm.DocStatus FROM dbo.ORIN rcm WHERE rcm.DocDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate) combined WHERE (@CardCode IS NULL OR combined.CardCode = @CardCode) AND (@DocStatus = 'ALL' OR combined.DocStatus = @DocStatus)
